title: myrtus aurantiifolia
intro: Myrtus aurantiifolia, commonly known as the orange myrtle, is a plant species that belongs to the family Myrtaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties. The therapeutic actions of M. aurantiifolia include reducing inflammation, treating respiratory infections, and providing antioxidant effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
